        15                  Lord God, we stand before You aware

         1                  This resolution before us urges the

         2       federal government to do all possible to

         3       mandate funding for veterans' healthcare

         4       services.  As we this very week will see units

         5       from Albany to Buffalo, National Guard units

         6       deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan, we owe these

         7       soldiers, brave men and women, a great deal.

         8                  We thank them for their service to

         9       our nation.  But that service doesn't end with

        10       their deployment.  It ends with a compact they

        11       have with the state and federal governments to

        12       continue in supporting their efforts and

        13       continue to support and ensure that they have

        14       adequate healthcare.

        15                  This resolution urges that support.

        16       And thank you, Mr. President, for the

        17       opportunity to speak in support.

        19       resolution, all those in favor please indicate

        24                  THE PRESIDENT:    The resolution is

        25       carried.
